title: 37 Months: Jackson's Ex-Mayor and the $50K FBI Sting

lines.say: Thirty-seven months in prison. That's the sentence for the former mayor of Jackson, Mississippi, who took fifty thousand dollars from developers secretly working for the F.B.I.
lines.show: 37 months in prison. That's the sentence for the former mayor of Jackson, Mississippi, who took $50,000 from developers secretly working for the FBI.

lines.say: On a yacht in Florida, Chokwe Antar Lumumba was handed five ten-thousand-dollar checks.
lines.show: On a yacht in Florida, Chokwe Antar Lumumba was handed five $10,000 checks.

scene.src: Indictment, U.S. v. Owens, Lumumba & Banks (S.D. Miss. 3:24-cr-103)

lines.say: He made one phone call, to move a city deadline up by fifteen days. The F.B.I. was recording.
lines.show: He made one phone call, to move a city deadline up by 15 days. The FBI was recording.
